subject.title: fix: preserve distinct imported CLI session messages

question: Should this maintainer-labeled PR require a redacted real Claude CLI import artifact before merge, rather than relying only on the focused unit test and reported Testbox result?
rationale: The patch is narrow and its unit regression matches the reported logic, but real behavior proof is the required merge gate for an external PR and the accessible evidence does not show a completed import outcome.

options.title: Request real import evidence
options.body: Ask for a redacted terminal transcript, log artifact, or recording that imports a Claude CLI session containing two same-text messages with distinct UUIDs and shows both retained.

options.title: Waive the proof gate
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept the focused regression and existing CI as sufficient for this internal merge-semantics change.

recommendation.title: Request real import evidence
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted terminal transcript, log artifact, or recording that imports a Claude CLI session containing two same-text messages with distinct UUIDs and shows both retained.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Claude CLI session-continuity work makes this the strongest available routing candidate for the identity contract.
